'''Manax-root poison''' was a lethal substance used for assassination.

==History==
During a [[Mission to Cato Neimoidia/Legends|trip to]] [[Cato Neimoidia/Legends|Cato Neimoidia]], [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]] [[Lott Dod/Legends|Lott Dod]] poisoned [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] with manax-root poison in an attempt to blackmail [[Baron/Legends|Baron]] [[Rush Clovis/Legends|Rush Clovis]], who was in love with her, into cooperating with his wishes. The poison had an [[Manax-root poison antidote|antidote]] that was administered by injection.

The poison itself was slow acting, as expected in that instance, taking [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] a full meal to start showing minor symptoms of headaches and tiredness and a few moments of wandering around to take the full effect of the poison knocking her into unconsciousness, the situation leads to believe that if not treated the poison would kill her in a few minutes or hours.

Once treated with the antidote, Padmé made a full recovery without any leftover symptoms.
